title: Kenyan Wrap with Tangy Vegetables
description: A French-inspired wrap filled with fresh vegetables and a tangy twist. Perfect for a quick and easy meal.

ingredients.name: Tangy Sauce (mayonnaise, lemon juice, chopped herbs)

instructions: Heat the tangy sauce in a pan over medium heat.
Add the sliced vegetables and cook for 3-4 minutes.
Warm the Kenyan wrap in the microwave for 10-15 seconds.
Assemble the wrap by adding the cooked vegetables, fixings, and quick pickled onions.
Drizzle with additional tangy sauce if desired.
